Building form limits

Source: R/zones.R
building_form.Rd

Limits on the shape and size of buildings that are not setbacks or site ratios. Areas in m2, lengths in m.

Usage

building_form(
  max_floorplate = NULL,
  min_floorplate = NULL,
  max_tower_floorplate = NULL,
  tower_above_height = NULL,
  tower_above_storey = NULL,
  max_tower_dimension = NULL,
  tower_separation = NULL,
  max_building_length = NULL,
  building_separation = NULL,
  max_building_depth = NULL,
  min_building_width = NULL,
  site_shape = NULL,
  max_site_floorspace = NULL,
  source = NULL
)

Arguments

max_floorplate

Maximum floor area of any storey.

min_floorplate

Smallest storey worth building; smaller storeys end the stack. Default from the rulebook defaults.

max_tower_floorplate, tower_above_height, tower_above_storey

Tower floorplate limit and where the tower starts.

max_tower_dimension

Maximum plan dimension of a tower.

tower_separation

Minimum distance between towers.

max_building_length

Maximum length of a building elevation.

building_separation

Minimum distance between buildings on a site: a number or bands() by height.

max_building_depth

Maximum building depth (e.g. 18 m for apartments).

min_building_width

Minimum building width.

site_shape

A length-2 vector c(width, depth): a rectangle that must fit on the site for it to be developable.

max_site_floorspace

Maximum floor area on one site.

source

Citation.

Value

A list with class plancap_form.

Examples

building_form(max_building_length = 20, building_separation = 10,
              source = "HRZ-S15, HRZ-S16")
#> $max_building_length
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $building_separation
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "HRZ-S15, HRZ-S16"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_form"
